name: phorvex-services
value:
{{- if and (eq .environment "staging") (or (eq .service "brain") (eq .service "manager") (eq .service "console")) }}
spec:
  sources:
  - helm:
      releaseName: '{{.release}}'
      skipCrds: true
      valueFiles:
      - $values/deploy/environments/{{.environment}}/phorvex.yaml
      - $values/deploy/environments/{{.environment}}/{{.service}}.yaml
      - $values/deploy/environments/{{.environment}}/catalogue-family.yaml
    path: '{{.chart}}'
    repoURL: https://github.com/PhorvexSecurity/operator-refactored.git
    targetRevision: 6ae89857369468d4ca39a6856d9fd55c3b5debd3
  - ref: values
    repoURL: https://github.com/PhorvexSecurity/operator-refactored.git
    targetRevision: 6ae89857369468d4ca39a6856d9fd55c3b5debd3
{{- end }}
expiry_condition: Remove this exact owned override after durable change is merged; stop and remove before allowing any unreviewed subsequent staging image/family release. Lead monitors main and effective images during this bounded campaign. No permanent main-tracking claim.
